<details open>

hybrid dna tokenizer fixes (#30825)

* vocab : support Carbon-14B HybridDNA tokenizer

Carbon-14B auto-tags untagged DNA runs and uses N-padded tail tokens
(tail=pad_n). Also strip whitespace inside <dna> tags and handle a stray
</dna> like the HF tokenizer.

* convert : fix special tokens and merges for older Carbon models

Carbon-500M/3B/8B don't register the Qwen added tokens and ship no
tokenizer.json, so take the token types, merges and special ids from the
base tokenizer.

* Update conversion/base.py
